_readme: Per-character combat skills. THERE IS ONE WAY TO LEARN ONE AND unlockLevel IS NOT IT: a non-book skill authors either 1 (the starting kit, and every monster ability) or 999 (unreachable on purpose -- something else hands it over: a reward track UnlockSkill node, or a talent grantsSkillId). Anything in between is refused by SkillEntryResolver and by ContentDatabase.Validation, naming the skill. The ladder is gone because a ladder PLUS a track is two systems handing out the same skill at two different moments with no rule about which wins (docs/handoffs/progression_v2/PLAN_PROGRESSION_V2.md section 1, contract 6). A bookOnly skill authors NO unlockLevel at all -- with one exception, and it is the one most likely to be got wrong. A bookOnly skill is never granted by the level ladder; a reward track may still name one. It belongs to whoever LEARNED it, not to whoever it was authored against. characterId on a book records who it was drafted for and nothing else -- all four book spells say 'sheep' because Shawn is who they were written for -- while run.learnedSpells records who actually bought it, and that is what a fight reads (ContentDatabase.AvailableSkillsFor). The shop has always offered a book to whoever is buying; this is that promise kept on the other end. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. These are DIFFERENT from spells.json: that is one global power curve every character shares, which only changes the name and number of the single Skill button; these are a character's own kit, shown as their own row of buttons in a fight. Damage is (Attack, scaled by the caster's own weapon or spell scaling depending on scalingAxis, + flatAmount + power x (resource spent), minus the target's Defense unless ignoresDefense is set, floored at 1) x10 — health pools are on a x10 scale and stat-derived damage is scaled to match (CombatMath.DamageScale). damageInstances is the exception: a list of {type, amount} packets written directly on the final scale and NOT multiplied, each one checked against the target's weakness and resistance on its own, so one cast can land at +50% and -50% at the same time — 25 Fire + 25 Frost against something that resists Frost and burns to Fire is 37 + 12, not 50 of something averaged. Mana restores are flatAmount + power x (resource spent). Heals are that PLUS the caster's Wisdom: half a percent of the caster's own max health per point of Wisdom above 10 (CombatMath.WisdomHealBonus), floored at neutral so a caster with no authored ability scores -- every monster -- heals exactly what it authored. That percentage shape is what lets one heal read sensibly at both ends of the game: Woolgathering (40 flat + 2 a wool, 4 wool, cooldownTurns 2) lands about 52 on a fresh Shawn (WIS 12, ~400 max health) and about 198 -- a fifth of the bar -- on a level-60 build that actually bought Wisdom (WIS 40, ~1000 max health). Both anchors are pinned literally in WoolgatheringHealTests. A skill must cost SOMETHING (manaCost and/or resourceCost); power scales per point actually spent, so a skill with power but no resource cost is rejected rather than silently scaling by zero. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.

skills.description: Cut the fleece loose and let it fly. Costs no mana at all, only wool.
Chew, breathe, and let the fleece knit the day back together.
Head down. Armour is a suggestion.
The bog answers. It arrives wearing whatever it picked up on the way.
Burns and freezes in the same breath. Something out there hates one half of it.
One crack runs the length of the floor, and everything standing on it finds out what is underneath.
A single white line from the ceiling to whatever is standing under it.

skills._comment: MILESTONE A of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.1. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification.
skills.description: Shields one ally. The gilding holds for two of their turns.

skills._comment: MILESTONE A, section 2.2. Frost resolves to DamageType.Ice -- Frost is a skills.json-only alias (SkillEntryResolver). appliesStatus Chilled is the FIRST content row in the game to author it, and it only slows anyone because ApplySkillStatus now goes through FightSession.ApplyStatusTo (plan D6). statusDuration 2 means two of the target's turns fully affected, the turn-end clock plan D1 put every standing modifier on.
skills.description: Frost damage, and the cold hangs on them for two turns.

skills._comment: MILESTONE A, section 2.3. The Poison-typed packet detonates whatever Poison the target already carries -- ALL of it, in one consumption, since Poison stacks (StatusCombos.SpendPoisonIfMatched) -- and the fresh Poison below lands afterwards, on a live target only, so the cast can never re-detonate what it just applied. The description is the tooltip and is worded exactly as the plan specifies.
skills.description: Detonates existing Poison, then poisons again.

skills._comment: MILESTONE B of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.4. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. consumesStatus/damageInstancesIfConsumed read and spend the GENERAL Marked status (Marks.cs), never the Drowned Lantern's own private mark set.
skills.description: Arcane damage. Far heavier against a marked enemy, and spends the mark.

skills._comment: MILESTONE B of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.5. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. requiresStatus/detonationPercent/detonationSplit build the Reclaim effect's whole damage from a consumed Poison pile; see StatusCombos.SpendPoisonIfMatched and ConsumedTotalSplit. No damageInstances of its own -- the packets are computed at resolution.
skills.description: Requires Poison. Rips it out and returns it burning, then leaves them open.

skills._comment: MILESTONE B of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.6. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. healthCostPercent is validated together with manaCost and paid directly (HealthCost), never through the damage funnel. ignoresDefense depends on the milestone B repair to ResolveDamageInstances (plan 1.3) -- without it this packet's bypass is inert.
skills.description: Costs blood. Ignores magical defence.

skills._comment: MILESTONE C of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.7. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. advanceSlots is measured in PLACES, not in charge -- one slot moves past one charge LEVEL, so two combatants tied at a level are jumped together and a slot with nobody above it clips (plan 1.9). No damage, no status, nothing left on the board: the whole cast is a position. It is refused outright, before payment, when the chosen ally is already next in the order.
skills.description: Moves an ally up to two places earlier in the order. Never buys them an extra turn.

skills._comment: MILESTONE C, section 2.8. queuePushSlots on a DamageAll row is NEW: the AOE branch applied status but never the push until this milestone, so the resolver refused the field on anything but DamageSingle and now accepts it on either damage effect. The delay is batched AFTER every enemy has resolved and every death has settled, over landed-hit survivors only -- a dodger keeps its place (plan 1.9 rule 6). Wind 5 per enemy, each checked against that enemy's own affinity.
skills.description: Wind damage to every enemy, and each one it hits loses a place in the order.

skills._comment: MILESTONE C, section 2.9. TWO PICKS, and the count is NOT authored: SkillEffects.PicksRequired reads it off the effect, because one more content number would let a row ask for three picks no resolution can use (plan 2.9). freeAction true is the caster's one free action a turn, the same lock Tuck In already uses. Either ally being Rooted refuses the cast before payment, the identical rule CanMove/Move read off both sides.
skills.description: Swap two allies. Free action. Neither may be rooted.

skills._comment: MILESTONE D, section 2.10. SkillEffect.Afflict: one enemy, this row's authored status, no damage -- so there is no damage instance, AfterDefences is never entered and the root cannot be dodged. statusDuration 2 is two EFFECTIVE turns under the milestone-A duration model (Rooted is AtTurnEnd, so the second turn's action is still restricted). The root now forbids every action classified physicalMove, on both sides, plus the formation Move it always forbade (plan 1.10). No scaling of any kind: a two-turn root is two turns from anyone, which is what keeps this a control spell rather than a damage spell in disguise.
skills.description: Binds one enemy for two turns. It cannot strike, charge or move - only cast.
Burns for three turns. Cast it again and both fires burn.
Thorns for three turns: damage at the start of each of its turns, and again whenever it strikes or charges.

skills._comment: MILESTONE F of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.13. Ordinary enemies take Fear; authored bosses use queuePushSlots as their fallback. appliesStatus is the caster's explicit price.
skills.description: Terrifies ordinary enemies for a turn. Bosses are only delayed. You are left open.
Head down, eyes up. Whatever it was going to do, it is going to do it to you.
Not elegant. Knocks the target a place down the order.
Three turns of something the fleece was hiding.

skills._comment: A SHIELD, not a percentage, since 2026-09-16 (AUDIT #152). flatAmount is the pool in shield points; sheep_lamb_ward_1's WardReductionPercent 40 scales it to 70 and Thicker Fleece's 60 to 80. It authored NO number at all before, because the talent used to BE the ward.
skills.description: A turn of the fleece, wrapped tight. A 50-point shield, and one turn to spend it.
Every ward he has out, broken at once, and every splinter goes somewhere.
A sound nothing in the room wants to swing through.
He has more wool than he has turns. Somebody else can have the difference.
Wound up like a spring, and pointed at something.
Go. Now. Do not wait for your turn.
Shawn's fourth ability is not designed yet.
skills.placeholderNote: Reward track V4 (level 30) needs an owner-designed ability -- docs/handoffs/progression_v2/PLAN_PROGRESSION_V2.md phase 0 sign-off. PLACED ON SHAWN's TRACK at level 30 by phase 4, so the node exists on the rail and the shape of the track is real; what it grants is not designed yet, and playerSelectable false means collecting it puts nothing on his command strip. Replace this entry with the real ability rather than adding a second one beside it, or the track will grant the stand-in forever.

skills.description: He folds the fleece over himself and waits. Spends up to 4 banked Wool for a 5-point shield a Wool -- 20 at a full four, standing for one turn. Costs no mana and does not end his turn -- once a turn.
The golem heaves a slab of the floor overhead and brings it down.
A killing blow that does not care what you are wearing.
A call that carries back through the trees. Something answers.
Caught, and held long enough to forget what you were about to do.
The plates fold shut and the beetle becomes a stone with legs.
Legs in, and the whole armoured weight of it comes through you.
It brings its whole upper half down like a felled tree.
The mushrooms along its back burst, and the air turns.
The bog answers. It arrives wearing whatever it picked up on the way.

Placeholder kit. He crosses the ground, gets the hammer over his head, and puts it through whatever is under it. Below 50 Fury it lands as a normal blow; at 50 or more it spends half his Fury for double damage; at 100 it spends it all for quadruple damage. He always throws the hardest hit he can afford.
Placeholder kit. Reuses the Provoke effect Shawn's own kit already defines.

skills._comment: cooldownTurns 2, not 1: the number counts from the turn it was cast on, so 2 is 'turn N, then turn N+2' and 1 is every turn -- SkillEntryResolver refuses 1 outright as indistinguishable from none. See SkillCooldownTests.ACooldownOfTwoMeansTurnOneThenTurnThree.
skills.description: Placeholder kit. A shield worth 20% of his own health, reusing the Ward effect Shawn's own kit already defines; placeholder_brawler_ward_root in talents.json deepens it by 40%. Not two turns running.

He stops picking targets. Seventy percent of a Slam, thrown at everything standing. Below 50 Fury it lands as a normal sweep; at 50 or more it spends half his Fury for double damage; at 100 it spends it all for quadruple. He always throws the hardest sweep he can afford.

skills._comment: bear_bulwark, not bulwark: ids are unique ACROSS content types and 'bulwark' is already an item modifier and an armour set. Same collision bog_mud_burst was named around.
skills.description: Fifty Fury, spent standing in front of somebody. A shield worth 30% of Bjorn's own health, and one turn to spend it.
He lets the whole rage go at once and breathes. Needs at least 25 Fury, spends every point of it, and heals 1% of his maximum health for each one -- a full bar is a full heal.
A held light Odette tunes to whichever element the moment wants, then throws. It never hits hard; it hits where it hurts.
A quiet word and a hand on the shoulder. Heals the chosen ally for 20 plus her spell attack.

skills._comment: scalingAxis Spell, SYMMETRICALLY with Mend beside it. The asymmetry that used to be here went with the ward model (AUDIT #152, 2026-09-16): a ward is a pool of shield POINTS now, so a spell attack that passes 80 late in a career buys a bigger shield rather than an immunity -- which is the same reason Mend was always allowed to scale. Authored as section 5's '20 plus spell attack'.
skills.description: Light bent into a shell around somebody else. A 20-point shield plus her spell attack, and one turn to spend it.
